title: 巴基斯坦财长：外汇储备创历史新高，卢比能否保持稳定？
speaker: Muhammad Aurangzeb

segments.en: What about when it comes to the bounds in the US dollar recently? I think managerial is that for Pakistan because we have been seeing in the past few years the rupee has been relatively stable. Do you think that can continue?
segments.zh: 最近美元走势方面呢？我认为这对巴基斯坦来说是可控的，因为过去几年我们看到卢比相对稳定。您认为这能持续吗？

segments.en: Yeah, I think the rupee has been stable because in the context of the overall macro stability. Because this time the effects reserves. You have to look at that the couple of weeks back we touched 21.4 billion dollars, which is the highest ever in the history of the country.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为卢比稳定是因为整体宏观稳定。因为这次外汇储备，您得看看，几周前我们达到了214亿美元，这是该国历史上最高水平。

segments.en: And this is now about three months of import cover which is a good international benchmark. And you put it in the context of couple of three years back when we were down to two weeks of import cover. So we have come a long way from that perspective number one.
segments.zh: 这现在大约是三个月的进口覆盖，是一个良好的国际基准。而两三年前我们只有两周的进口覆盖。所以从那个角度看，我们已经走了很长的路。

segments.en: Number two these reserves are not built on desktop. This is the central bank actually doing market interventions. So it's not only the quantum of the effects reserve but also the quality of effects reserve which is helping the stability of the currency.
segments.zh: 第二，这些储备不是纸上谈兵。这是央行实际进行市场干预的结果。所以不仅是外汇储备的数量，还有外汇储备的质量，都在帮助货币稳定。

segments.en: And while as you can appreciate the effects and the policy rate is very much the purview of the central bank. But all I can say is that we expect the currency to remain stable as we move forward.
segments.zh: 如您所知，外汇和政策利率很大程度上属于央行的职责范围。但我能说的是，我们预计未来货币将保持稳定。

segments.en: Do you see there being a risk to growth? We've already been seeing previously the INF downgrading the outlook for this year because of the vulnerabilities from the energy shock. How on target are you? What is the target for this year?
segments.zh: 您认为增长有风险吗？我们之前已经看到IMF因能源冲击的脆弱性而下调今年展望。你们的达标情况如何？今年的目标是什么？
